purpose: Explain how to add or change a navbar link to an existing page on an already published site.
stated_prerequisites: A page exists to link to.
expected_next_action: Continue into the guide if the page exists; otherwise, follow “create it first.”

findings.exact_quote: Use this guide when your site is already published and you have a page to link to.
findings.concern: Explicitly establishes applicability for an author with a published site and an existing destination page.

findings.exact_quote: A menu entry does not create a page.
findings.concern: Clarifies the distinction between adding navigation and creating its destination.

findings.exact_quote: # Add or change a menu link
findings.concern: The opening identifies the task but does not show the menu-editing action; whether subsequent instructions provide it requires checking the full page.

uncertainties: The excerpt does not establish where or how to edit the menu.
The destination of “create it first” was not inspected.
